what: The full-screen Hero (video or photo) shrinks during the first 100px of scroll by twice the side margin (20px) (scale 1 − 40/screen width) while its corners round from 0 → 6px, lifting like a card, and then until the Hero fully scrolls away the inner video drops 60svh late and the text 20svh late, splitting the depth — no curve, tied directly to scroll. Not applied below 1024px

options.media: Share by which the video descends late (screen height %), default 60
options.content: Amount the text lags when descending (% of screen height), default 20
options.narrow: Not applied at or below this width (px), default 1024

note: The original pulls the header, hidden during the same scroll, up from below the screen (1.1 screens − 100px) and sets it in place — this is a header mechanism, so it is not in the part (the side that reads --fx-p2 hooks it up)

from.where: index.html Hero (original p-front: --p1 top top → +=100px · --p2 top −100px → bottom top, video 60svh · text 20svh)
